## Summary

- `RigidBody` enum `Component` in `bsengine-core` — `Dynamic | Kinematic | Static`
- `Default` is `Dynamic`
- Helper predicates: `is_dynamic()`, `is_kinematic()`, `is_static()`, `is_affected_by_forces()`
- Physics systems check `RigidBody` before applying gravity/damping/impulses

## Test plan

- [ ] CI All Green (4 unit tests — one per variant + default)
- [ ] `is_affected_by_forces()` true only for Dynamic
